suggested_visuals.section_heading: Why Arcade Machine ROI Questions Deserve a Clear-Eyed Answer
suggested_visuals.purpose: Ground the topic in a realistic adult venue setting without branding, per the editor requirement that no JVL/ECHO machine appear above the closing product section
suggested_visuals.alt_text_proposal: Bartop arcade machine on the end of a bar counter in a quiet, warmly lit venue
suggested_visuals.production_note: Generic, unbranded bartop-style machine or a tightly cropped angle where no logo is visible. Evening bar lighting, adult setting, no people required.

suggested_visuals.section_heading: Comparison Table: Weekly Revenue and Payback Period by Scenario
suggested_visuals.purpose: Let the reader see the seven-fold spread between pessimistic and optimistic payback at a glance
suggested_visuals.alt_text_proposal: Bar chart comparing arcade machine payback period of 41, 12.4 and 5.8 months across pessimistic, base case and optimistic scenarios
suggested_visuals.production_note: Simple horizontal bar chart, three bars, months on the x-axis. Highlight the base-case bar in the brand accent colour and label it 'plan around this'.

suggested_visuals.section_heading: Net Monthly Profit After Payback: What Happens Next
suggested_visuals.purpose: Show visually that payback is a crossover point, not an endpoint - the line keeps climbing after month 12
suggested_visuals.alt_text_proposal: Cumulative cash flow chart for a bar arcade machine showing break-even at month 12 and continued profit through month 36
suggested_visuals.production_note: Single line, 0-36 months on x-axis, cumulative net dollars on y-axis, starting at -$4,250. Mark the zero crossing at month 12.4.

suggested_visuals.section_heading: Where the JVL ECHO Fits Into This Picture
suggested_visuals.purpose: Make the Home vs Commercial Edition distinction concrete by showing the payment hardware that only the Commercial Edition has
suggested_visuals.alt_text_proposal: Close-up of the bill and coin acceptor on a JVL ECHO HD3 Commercial Edition bartop arcade machine
suggested_visuals.production_note: Real product photo of the Commercial Edition acceptor area. This is the first and only place in the article where branded ECHO imagery is permitted.
